0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-5, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East) for the Hawks' eighth game of the season, with Atlanta coming off a loss and the Pacers on a four-game losing streak and 0-3 at home. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Kingston Flemings (suspension), while Indiana is without Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but the last meeting was on January 31, 2026, in Indianapolis, where Atlanta lost 129-124.
